newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian Authority condemns Tel Aviv bombing.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian Authority condemns Tel Aviv bombing.

text.p: The Palestinian Authority condemned the apparent Arab suicide bombing of a Tel Aviv cafe on Friday which killed at least three people and injured up to 40.

"The stance of the Palestinian Authority is that it cannot accept any of these kinds of operations no matter the motive," Ahmad Abdel-Rahman, secretary of Palestinian President Yasser Arafat's cabinet told Israel Radio in Arabic.

Asked if there was still a peace process with Israel, Hanan Ashrawi, the minister of Higher Education in the Palestinian Authority, told the Cable News Network: "It is very, very hard to tell if there is one.
"It is on its dying bed. I hope there is enough will to try and save it," she said.

Israeli security officials had warned that Palestinian violence, including possible suicide attacks, could erupt in anger at Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's groundbreaking this week on a new Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
